If you want to back up your saved usernames and passwords or move them to a different application, the [[Password Manager - Remember, delete and edit logins and passwords in Firefox|Firefox password management feature]] allows you to export this data to a <code>.csv</code> (comma separated values) file.
{warning}'''Warning:''' Your passwords in the exported file will not be encrypted and will be in a readable form to anyone who can view this file. Do not upload online, email or share the exported file. Delete this file when finished.{/warning}
You can also [[Import data from another browser|import login data from another browser]]{for fx116}, or [[Import login and password data from a file|import login and password data from a file]]{/for}.

=Export your login data from Firefox=

#Select {menu Export Logins…} from the dropdown.
#;{for not fx116}[[Image:Fx89logins3-dotMenuExport-win]]{/for}{for fx116}[[Image:Fx121LoginsMenuExport-Simplified]]{/for}

{/for}
